notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states "The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: all countries 7,900 EUR" per semester, but adds "Tuition fees may vary" and points to the programme website for an exact breakdown; no fee specific to non-EU applicants for this Bachelor programme is stated with a quotable figure, so tuition is left out. Application channel: the pages do not state uni-assist or an own-portal route for international applicants (the DAAD page only says "Submit application via Please check this website."), so applicationChannel is left out. Documents: the quotes name the high school diploma/school leaving certificate and an official language certificate; no separate transcript document is named for international applicants (the transcript sentence addresses applicants who have not yet received their final certificate).
